blocks.text: Disclaimer: This paid article is intended for US audiences. England’s attack has started to look more dangerous, with Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham, Bukayo Saka and Anthony Gordon showing how effective the team can be when its forwards and midfielders work together. The clearest evidence came in October 2026, when England beat Croatia 7-0 away from home before defeating Czechia 3-0 at Wembley in the UEFA Nations League. The two victories offered more than a collection of goals. They showed a team capable of creating chances through quick passing, direct runs and movement between the lines.
